description.value: Baan Wasana is a family-owned Thai restaurant in Vancouver's Kerrisdale neighbourhood, serving homestyle family-style Thai food since 2005. The restaurant takes its name from its owner, Wasana — 'Baan' meaning 'house' in Thai — reflecting her philosophy that every guest is welcomed as if in her own home. The menu spans classic Thai appetizers, soups, salads, curries, and stir-fries, built around the four foundational Thai flavour profiles: sweet, sour, salty, and spicy.
